title: A Comprehensive Survey on Trustworthiness in Reasoning with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing experiments that paraphrase standard English queries into African American Vernacular English (AAVE) to evaluate model performance and discrepancies.
Summarizing studies that evaluate whether Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting guides language models to correctly classify gender biases.
Reviewing evaluations of multiple prompting strategies (e.g., system 2 prompts with human personas) to measure the reduction of stereotypical judgments.

Surveying the use of comprehensive benchmarks (e.g., CLEAR-Bias) and the development of guardrail models (e.g., BiasGuard) to identify potential discrimination and bias vulnerabilities in explicit reasoning models.
